newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain had 1.33 tln budget deficit at end June.
newsitem.headline: Spain had 1.33 tln budget deficit at end June.

text.p: The Economy Ministry said on Wednesday the central government budget, on a national account basis, had a deficit of 1.33 trillion pesetas at the end of June versus 967.1 billion at the end on May.
This represents 1.7 percent of gross domestic product.
Further details on revenues and expenditures will be published shortly, a spokesman for the Economy Ministry told Reuters.

The central government public deficit on a national account basis is the one relevant for the Maastricht Treaty, which sets out the economic requirements that must be met to join the European single currency launch.
It takes into account accrued revenues and expenditures for a given period, while the deficit on a cash basis registers actual money movements during a given month.
